newsitem.title: ITALY: ALPINE SKIING-GHEDINA WINS VAL GARDENA DOWNHILL.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-GHEDINA WINS VAL GARDENA DOWNHILL.

text.p: Kristian Ghedina joined Herbert Plank as Italy's most successful ever World Cup downhill skier on Saturday after turning the tables on his French rival Luc Alphand.
Ghedina, third behind Alphand in Friday's shortened downhill, clocked two minutes 0.28 seconds to beat the Frenchman, whose time was 2:00.51, into second place.
Josef Strobl restored some Austrian pride after his countrymen were knocked out of the top five on Friday with a third place in a provisional time of 2:00.65.
Ghedina, who last won a race in 1995, has now won five World Cup downhills -- the same number as Plank and the most any Italian has ever achieved. Plank won here in 1977.
